name: forecast
description: Shows how long your Claude Code turns usually take, as a range from your own past turns, with a live clock while Claude works. Warns when Claude has a major incident.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn Forecast off without uninstalling. Off means nothing is shown and nothing is recorded.

band.title: Range width
band.description: 50 shows the middle half of your similar past turns. 80 shows the middle 8 in 10: wider, but misses less often.

show_result.title: Show actual time
show_result.description: After each turn, show how long it really took and whether that was inside the forecast.

check_status.title: Check Claude status
check_status.description: Read status.claude.com (cached 2 minutes) to warn when Claude Code or the API has an incident. Nothing is sent except the request itself.

mark.title: Mark
mark.description: What starts each line: symbol (the ☊☋ Dragon's Head and Tail), RD (plain letters, if your terminal shows boxes) or none.

model.title: Range source
model.description: global (default): a range from your first turn, from a model shared by everyone that runs on your machine and reads only numbers (prompt length, this session's turn times, your recent turn times); after 30 turns, your own history is used whenever it has been closer for you. local: only your own past turns, nothing until 10 turns.

server_send_text.title: Compare with RainDragon's server model (sends your prompt)
server_send_text.description: Off by default. On: each prompt's text (first 8,000 characters; never the conversation, files or paths) is sent to inference.raindragon.ai, which predicts the reply length and does not keep the text. The answer is logged next to the local range so /forecast:eval can compare them. Nothing is sent while this is off.

server_mode.title: Server model use
server_mode.description: Only with the option above on. shadow (default): ask the server but keep showing your local range. server: show the server's range. blend: show a mix of both. off: never ask. server and blend fall back to the local range until 10 turns have a server answer, and on any error or after 0.8 s.

server_url.title: Server address
server_url.description: Where the server model is. Leave as is.
